navigation.verify: python3 host/dshtv.py state  and  python3 host/dshtv.py ui
navigation.rule: Never assume an app is open; launch, wait, then check state/ui. Screenshots can be black on DRM playback.

apps.label: Aerial Views
apps.notes: Aerial screensaver; launch to test dreams/screensaver behaviour.

apps.label: TDUK Screensaver Manager
apps.notes: TDUK Screensaver Manager: force/disable screensavers.

apps.label: DeepSeek TV
apps.notes: This app: bridge + Whale-chan overlay + pairing. MainActivity = control panel.

apps.label: Whale-chan (assistant shortcut)
apps.notes: Whale-chan shortcut shim (claims the Disney+ button package). Opens com.jp.dshtv/.WhaleActivity.

apps.label: Projectivy Launcher
apps.notes: Projectivy home. HOME should open Google TV; launch Projectivy explicitly when needed. It caches icons/labels.

apps.label: Movie Art for Projectivy
apps.notes: Projectivy movie-art add-on.

apps.label: Projectivy Wallpaper : Overflight
apps.notes: Projectivy wallpaper provider.

apps.label: JapanTV
apps.notes: Japanese channels; browsing is list-based.

apps.label: OwnTV
apps.notes: Cobalt web app; use ui to read the page, D-pad to move.

apps.label: TiviMate
apps.notes: TiviMate: channel lists + EPG. Use MENU for playback options; favourites are fastest to navigate.

apps.label: CloudStream

search.note: Search icon in the left sidebar; account-select screen may appear first.

apps.notes: Multiple providers; results need a provider pick before playback.

apps.label: Netflix

search.note: Sidebar Search is above Home; confirm with ui if the focus order differs.

apps.notes: DRM: screenshots are black in playback. Use ui/state, not screenshots, to verify playback.

apps.label: Prime Video

search.note: Search lives in the top nav; navigate up then across; verify with ui.

apps.notes: DRM playback; screenshots black.

apps.label: Stremio

search.note: LEFT opens the sidebar (focus lands on Home), UP moves to Search, OK opens the keyboard; typing + ENTER shows Series/AI search sections.

apps.notes: Primary player for anime/K-drama; addons can load slowly — wait and use ui after ENTER.

apps.label: Amazon Music
apps.notes: Music; search via the top bar.

apps.label: Surfshark
apps.notes: VPN; check connection state before geo-restricted apps.

apps.label: Haystack News
apps.notes: News clips; linear list.

apps.label: Play Games
apps.notes: Play Games overlay.

apps.label: Play Store
apps.notes: Play Store; use only when the user asks to install/update.

apps.label: Projector OSD
apps.notes: Projector OSD remote; accessibility filter-key capability.

apps.label: Settings
apps.notes: TV settings; accessibility, network, apps.

apps.label: tvQuickActions Pro
apps.notes: Button remapper. Its accessibility service can filter keys (it once hijacked HOME → Stremio via Button HOME mapping). Check Mappings before blaming the remote.

apps.label: BROWSER
apps.notes: Browser; D-pad + on-screen keyboard. Use ui to read page text.

apps.label: Downloader
apps.notes: URL downloader; type an address into the field then Download.

apps.label: MiX
apps.notes: File manager; useful for APK sideloading.

apps.label: Send Files To TV
apps.notes: LAN file transfer; sender/receiver roles.

apps.label: YouTube

search.note: Top bar search; navigate up then toward the magnifier; verify with ui.

apps.notes: Long ads; DRM may black out captures.
